m: The {Ghost} rises out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut} and sprints for the *road*, wailing. A giant glowing *question mark* swings down like a shepherd's crook, hooks him by the collar and yanks him back. "Why?" the Ghost moans. The *question mark* only tightens its grip: its job is **to restrain** him, and it **restrains** him all night long.

The {Sheriff} kicks open the {Trapdoor} of the {Warehouse} and finds a *campfire* someone lit among the crates. Every spark that pops out rings like tiny *joy bells* and hangs in the air, glowing. Soon the whole dark warehouse twinkles, **luminous** as a Christmas tree, and the Sheriff's badge shines so **luminous** he has to wear sunglasses indoors.

The {Shepherd} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Youth Hostel} with his nose twitching. A terrible *stink* drifts from the bunk room. He opens his *mouth* wide and goes **sniff**, **sniff**, sniffing every sock and sleeping bag like a bloodhound, until all the backpackers line up so he can **sniff** them one by one.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} behind a pair of red *curtains*. The curtains whip open, and an enormous *mouth* pokes out and shouts "BANG!" so loudly that every bather leaps out of the hot tub. Towels fly, cucumbers fly. **Bang**, says the mouth again, and the *curtains* swish shut. **Bang!**

The {Ghost} drifts down the {Staircase} of the {Tower} carrying a cauldron. A weary *wanderer* sits on every step, blowing on a pile of *embers* to keep it barely glowing. The cauldron is passed down step by step, and the soup inside starts **to simmer**, slowly, for a hundred years. The Ghost tastes it and sighs: let it **simmer** a little longer.

The {Pirate} lounges on the {Rooftop} of the {Yeti Cave}, wrapped in filthy *rags*. A Yeti stomps past below. The pirate lifts one corner of his rags and a single *eye* peeks out for a split-second **glance**, then the rags drop again. Snap. Another quick **glance**. The Yeti never catches him looking.

The {Hunter} tiptoes up the rickety {Staircase} on the {Island} and finds a *wild boar* made entirely of *bone*, clattering up the steps behind him. It snorts dust. The hunter screams and the whole **skeleton** falls apart into a heap, then reassembles itself, wrong way round. Now the **skeleton** walks backwards, chasing him in reverse.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} and finds a *big man* lounging on a golden sofa, eating diamonds on toast. A *busy man* rushes around him, gluing gold leaf to the chimney and pouring champagne into the rain gutter. "Too **extravagant**!" yells the Sheriff. "Not **extravagant** enough," says the big man, ordering a solid-gold weathervane.

The {Jockey} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Warehouse} to stack a *double mountain* of boxes. A huge *helping hand* reaches in to help, but it is so **clumsy** that it knocks both mountains over, slaps the jockey off his feet, and drops the last box on its own thumb. Boxes rain down the fire escape. What a **clumsy** hand.

The {Dentist} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Lagoon} and lands beside a *tree* growing straight up out of the water toward the *east*. Every time the sun rises in the east, the tree sprouts another floor, windows and all. By breakfast it is a ten-storey **building**, and the Dentist opens a surgery on the top floor of the **building**.

The {Tailor} stomps down into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} with a bundle of *fur*. A *blaze* roars in the furnace, so he lays the fur in front of it, sews it flat, and rolls out a giant fluffy **rug**. The butler trips over the **rug**, the rug trips the cat, and the cat ends up asleep on the warm fur by the blaze.

The {Tailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} with a *matching cup* in each hand. At the top grows a broad-leaved *tree* with huge purple flowers, a **paulownia**, shaped exactly like teacups. The tailor holds up his cups and they match perfectly. He drinks purple flower tea under the **paulownia** until his whole suit turns violet.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} holding a huge *stone*. He crushes it in his fist, then takes a *pinch* of what is left and sprinkles it on the bathers below. More pinches, more pinches: soon the hot tub is full of **sand**, the guests are buried to their necks, and someone builds a **sand** castle on the massage table.

The {Magician} crashes down into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} on a motorbike, straight through a wall of tall *grass* that grows there for no reason. He doesn't look, he doesn't brake, he just revs and smashes through every stalk, scattering bats and aeroplane parts. "That was **reckless**!" shouts a pilot. The Magician grins, being even more **reckless**, and drives up the wall.

The {Shepherd} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Yeti Cave} and lands on a *writing desk*. *Water drops* start dripping on it, then gushing, until the desk drawers spring open and the water **pours out** of them in waterfalls. The Yeti, soaked, keeps trying to write a letter while ink **pours out** of the pen as well.

The {Pirate} stomps down the {Staircase} into the {Boxing Ring} carrying sacks of *soil*. He dumps them in the ring and rolls them perfectly *flat* with a steamroller, until the ring is a wide open **plain** with grass and grazing cows. The boxers have to jog for an hour across the **plain** just to reach each other.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} combing a *tumbling baby*'s wild hair. The baby keeps rolling away, so the Sheriff snaps a branch from a *tree*, and the branch's twigs line up into a wooden **comb**. Every time the baby tumbles past, the Sheriff gives it one neat stroke with the **comb**, until its hair is a perfect quiff.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} where a tall *tree* has sprouted through the slates. It is covered in stiff green *bristles* instead of leaves. He brushes his moustache on it, and the bristles prickle like a hedgehog. "It's a **fir**," the gardener calls. The Sheriff hangs his hat on the **fir** and it smells of Christmas.

The {Wizard} pops up through the {Trapdoor} beside the {Pool}. The *sun* and a big black *speaker* are sitting at a table by the water. They have never been introduced. The Wizard waves his wand: "Sun, **meet** Speaker!" The speaker booms "PLEASED TO MEET YOU" and the sun blushes orange. They agree **to meet** every afternoon for a swim.

The {Jockey} rides through the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} on a tiny *sparrow*. The sparrow is so **young** it still has fluff on its head, and it keeps pecking at a *grain stalk* instead of flying. Baby bees crowd round, also very **young**, and they all chew the grain together, squeaking, while the jockey tries to look serious.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} and pulls the plug on an *unclogged drain*. Instead of water, *grass* shoots up, then carrots, cabbages, leeks and peas, a geyser of **vegetables** raining down on the swimmers. Everyone at the pool is pelted with sprouts and has to eat their **vegetables** before they can get out.

The {Yogi} floats down the {Staircase} of the {Boxing Ring}, meditating, but a buzzing *bug* keeps landing on his nose. A big green *frog* hops into the ring, shoots out its tongue, and misses the **fly** every time, slapping the Yogi instead. The **fly** buzzes off laughing, and the Yogi gives up meditating to go fly-swatting.

The {Dentist} goes down into the {Basement} of the {Tower} where a tiny *island* floats in a puddle. A giant *helping hand* with a pestle starts **to pound** the island, thump, thump, thump, grinding palm trees and sand into paste. The Dentist covers his ears; the whole tower shakes as the hand keeps **pounding** until the island is powder.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels into the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} and finds a giant *tilted head* lying on its side. She measures it with a tape: it covers exactly one **unit of area**, a whole field. "Give me an A! Give me an R! Give me an E-A!" she chants, and the head grumbles that it is one **unit of area** and no more.

The {Magician} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Fort} holding a bundle of *hemp*. He pulls out a *tiny thread*, then cuts it in half, and in half again, until it is so **tiny** no one can see it. He bows. The audience squints at an empty hand. "**Tiny**," he whispers, and threads a needle with nothing.

The {Gardener} hobbles onto the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} on a *crutch*, and the crutch snaps right in front of the *inspector*. The gardener falls into the chimney and comes out sooty, holding the inspector's toupee. Silence. Nobody knows where to look. It is horribly **awkward**, and it gets more **awkward** when the toupee starts to sneeze.

The {Baker} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Cat Café} throwing a **dart** made of *gold coins* stacked into a spike. It flies across the street and pins a *ticket* to the wall: a free lifetime of cream cakes. Below, a hundred cats leap after the ticket, so the Baker throws another **dart** to win them all a saucer of milk.

The {Chef} pokes his head up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa}. A *small speech bubble* floats out of an empty *dwelling* in the steam room and says, "Hello, I live here." The Chef is so **astonished** his hat flies off and his eyebrows shoot up into the steam. The bathers, equally **astonished**, all drop their cucumbers at once.

The {Gardener} crashes through the {Trapdoor} into the {Spa}, still leaning on her *crutch*, right between two strangers on a blind date. The *go-between* who arranged it freezes. Everyone stares at the gardener, dripping and covered in mud. It is very **embarrassing**. Then her crutch sinks into the hot tub with a loud gurgle, which is even more **embarrassing**.

The {Lifeguard} drags a smoking yellow *stone* up the {Staircase} of the {Youth Hostel}. It smells of rotten eggs. A *tumbling baby* rolls down the steps past him, gets a whiff and turns green. "It's **sulfur**!" screams the warden. Every backpacker grabs a pillow to cover their nose as the **sulfur** fumes chase the baby back upstairs.

The {Juggler} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Cat Café} juggling a *wine goblet* above his open *mouth*. Each time it falls he catches it in his teeth and starts **to chew**: crunch, crunch, crunch. He chews the goblet, the saucer and a cat's toy mouse. The cats watch, then begin **to chew** his shoelaces in sympathy.

The {Shepherd} pops up through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} with one scruffy *sheep*. Ahead is a long *queue* of fluffy, shampooed sheep, each carrying a bag of yen. His sheep stares at their glossy wool and turns green: it starts **to envy** them all. The Shepherd looks at their money bags and starts **to envy** too.

The {Lifeguard} stands on the {Staircase} of the {Casino} as *water drops* trickle down from above, then pour. A *neat stack* of gambling chips sits on each step, and one by one the stacks begin **to sink**, glug, glug, glug, under the rising flood. The Lifeguard blows his whistle at the chips, but they keep **sinking** to the bottom.

The {Hunter} climbs out of the {Trapdoor} by the {Pool} and finds a *door* standing on its own in the water, *water drops* streaming from it. He opens it and sees skyscrapers, river boats and neon: **Shanghai**. He steps through, dripping, buys a soup dumpling on the Bund, then comes back through the door with the whole of **Shanghai** in his pockets.

The {King} sneaks down through the {Trapdoor} into the {Swamp} and hides in a muddy *shed* when he should be at school. Through a hole in the roof the *sun* shines on him like a spotlight. "Aha! You decided **to skip class**!" bellows his teacher, a frog. The King argues that kings are allowed **to skip class**, then sinks into the mud.

The {Baker} steps out onto the {Rooftop} of the {Inn}, where a little *grove* of trees grows in pots. Each tree has neatly combed *bristles* instead of leaves, parted down the middle. They bow politely to him and offer him tea. "Such **well-bred** trees," he says, and bows back. A **well-bred** pigeon curtseys too and nibbles his croissant very daintily.

The {Yogi} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Spa} in a perfect lotus position. A green *fang* pokes up through the *grass* between his toes and keeps growing, uncurling two tiny leaves: a **sprout**. He breathes in, it grows. He breathes out, it grows more. By sunset every step of the spa is green with **sprouts**, and the bathers are wading through a salad.

The {Lifeguard} jogs up the {Staircase} at the {Beach} and meets a *prowling dog* with stripes, a bushy tail and tufted ears. It is not a dog at all: it is a **wild cat**, sneaking back from raiding the fishing *village*. It hisses, steals the Lifeguard's sandwich and vanishes into the dunes. "Another **wild cat**," sigh the villagers.

The {Magician} trots down the {Staircase} into the {Boxing Ring} with a huge *cloth cover*. He throws it over the *dim sun* that lights the ring, and everything goes **dark**: pitch-black, boxers punching the air. "Ta-da!" he says. Nobody can see him bow. In the **dark** a boxer punches the referee, who punches the Magician.

The {Tailor} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into the cellar, onto a heap of black *charcoal* and one white *stone*. He tries to sew the charcoal into a suit, but everything he touches turns sooty black. "Pure **carbon**," says a passing chemist. The tailor's tape measure, scissors and teeth are now all **carbon** too, and he grins like a chimney.

The {Lifeguard} stomps into the {Basement} of the {Yeti Cave}, where a *lineup* of yetis stands for a photo. "Say cheese!" he shouts. Every *mouth* stretches wider and wider, ear to ear, until the yetis **grin** so broadly their heads almost split. The flash goes off. In the photo even the Lifeguard can't help **grinning**.

The {Tailor} falls through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} and sees a *lizard* sunbathing on a red *standing heart*. The lizard opens one eye. The heart beats faster. The Tailor takes one step, the lizard tenses; another step, the heart freezes. Both are **wary**, watching each other for hours, and the Tailor stays very **wary** of lizards ever after.

The {Sheriff} stomps down into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a *busy man* is shovelling the *sun* into a furnace. The basement glows red. Sweat pours off the sheriff's moustache, the pool boils above them, and the swimmers come out pink. "Turn down the **heat**!" he yells. The busy man shovels faster, and the **heat** melts the Sheriff's badge.

The {Gardener} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Hut} when a *visitor* climbs up the chimney. The visitor opens a huge *mouth* and lets out a **cackle**: "Ka-ka-ka-ka!" Hens all over the farm answer, cackling back. The gardener tries to shoo the visitor off, but each push makes it **cackle** louder, until the roof is covered in chickens.

The {Lifeguard} jogs up the {Staircase} of the {Warehouse} dragging a *gauze net* full of *grass*. He tips it out and pulls on a leaf, and up comes a giant white **radish**, as big as a sofa. He pulls another: a pink one. Soon the warehouse stairs are blocked with rolling **radishes**, and he has to surf down on one.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Youth Club} when someone triggers a *booby trap*. A few *water drops* spit out, then a **torrential** flood bursts from every window, sweeping ping-pong tables, guitars and teenagers into the street. The Shepherd clings to the chimney as his sheep surf past on the **torrential** wave.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} at night, staring at the *moon*. A *star* falls out of the sky and lands at his feet, flapping. It's a starfish, and it smells terribly **fishy**. The moon wrinkles its nose. Soon the whole sky reeks: every star is **fishy**, and seagulls circle the ring.

The {King} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Waiting Room} and finds a tiny *cave* in the slates. He crouches and puts his eye to it to **peep** inside, holding a *compass* to guide him. Below, the patients are all playing cards. The compass needle points at the best hand, so the King keeps **peeping** and calling out bets.

The {Ghost} pops up in the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, where a *standing person* is fumbling with a torch. A *sudden flash* lights the room. "Who's there?" the person shrieks. "Me! **I**!" says the Ghost, pointing proudly at himself with both hands. "**I** live here," he adds, and flashes the torch under his chin for effect.

The {Tailor} slips on the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} and tumbles down, step after step, followed by a waterfall of *water drops*. At the bottom the water collects into a **deep pool**, so deep the Tailor sinks out of sight with only his top hat floating. Goldfish move in. The butler starts selling tickets for a dip in the **deep pool**.

The {Cheerleader} bounces up the {Staircase} at the {Beach}, but the stairs keep sprouting into a *mountain*, then another, then a jagged range. An *oddball* in a snorkel sits on each peak, waving. The whole beach becomes **mountainous**, all cliffs and ridges, and the Cheerleader has to pom-pom her way over the **mountainous** sand to reach the sea.

The {Lifeguard} hears hooves on the {Staircase} of the {Inn}. A *deer* with dragon scales clatters up the steps, a *will-o'-the-wisp* glowing on its single horn like a lantern. It is a **qilin**! Guests faint into their porridge. The **qilin** blesses the innkeeper's baby, eats the doormat and trots off over the rooftops.

The {Juggler} tumbles into the {Basement} of the {Yen Exchange} where a whole *assembly* of coins has spilled across the floor. A giant *helping hand* swoops down **to pick up** every coin, one by one, and flicks them into his juggling act. Ten coins, fifty coins, a thousand. The manager screams, and bends **to pick up** his false teeth.

The {Jockey} plunges into the {Basement} of the {Jungle}, where his *assistant* is sinking in quicksand, still taking notes. A huge *helping hand* bursts out of a tree and grabs the assistant by the ponytail, swinging him free. "We must **rescue** the notes too!" the assistant cries, so the hand dives back **to rescue** the clipboard.

The {Juggler} wobbles up the icy {Staircase} of the {Ice Rink} to the edge of a *cliff*. He gets a *hiccup*, hic!, and drops all ten balls over the edge. Another hiccup: he goes pale, rolls his eyes and starts **to faint**, toppling backwards onto the ice. Every skater who sees it hiccups too, and they **faint** in a heap.

The {Chef} climbs the mossy {Staircase} in the {Jungle} behind a *climber* hauling a muddy bucket of *water drops*. At the top the climber shakes the bucket and the mud falls away: the water turns **clear**, clear as glass. The Chef can see straight through it to a goldfish winking at him. Even the air grows **clear**.

The {Wizard} goes down into the {Basement} of the {Lake} where a lawn of *grass* grows by a lamp. He casts a gloomy spell. Every blade droops into a *wilting stalk*, brown and floppy, and his roses begin **to wither** too. The Wizard's own beard goes limp. The lake frogs sigh as even the water lilies **wither** into crisps.

The {Zookeeper} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Island} holding a long *lance*. On its tip is skewered a huge *mouth* that cannot stop shouting, "Alas! Ah! Oh!" in dramatic poetry. Every gasp is an **exclamation**. The parrots copy it. Soon the whole island rings with **exclamations** and the Zookeeper puts earplugs in the mouth.

The {Wizard} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Fort} stirring a gigantic *wok*. *Water drops* rain into it and he stirs faster and faster until the water spins into a roaring **whirlpool**. Cannonballs, soldiers and a goat get sucked in, going round and round. The **whirlpool** spits them out over the walls, dizzy.

The {Tailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} with a *rice scoop*, ladling *water drops* from a bucket over the edge. But the scoop never empties: water surges out of it in a raging **torrent**, roaring down the tower, flooding the streets. The tailor tries to stop it with his thumb, and the **torrent** blasts him into the clouds.

The {Shepherd} lounges on the {Staircase} of the {Piazza} in the *sun*. He has a *borrowed tool* for mending fences but has no intention of using it: it is his day of **leisure**. He uses the tool as a back-scratcher, a straw and a pillow. Pigeons join him, sunbathing. **Leisure**, he sighs, and orders an ice cream.

The {Sailor} plunges through the {Trapdoor} into the {Pool}, where *water drops* are flowing in a strong current. A silver *new moon* rises from the water like a canoe. The Sailor jumps in and paddles **upstream**, against the current, all the way to the filter pipe. The swimmers cheer as he **goes upstream** into the plumbing.

The {Lifeguard} drags a huge *fish* up the {Staircase} of the {Inn}. A *will-o'-the-wisp* floats beside it and lights it up, and every **scale** on the fish glitters like a coin. The fish shakes, and **scales** fly everywhere, sticking to guests' faces until everyone in the inn shimmers like a mermaid.

The {Ninja} springs out of the {Trapdoor} in the {Stadium} carrying a *wine jug*. He tips in the leftovers of a *good meal*, rice, plums, a whole cake, and seals it. The jug bubbles and burps through the match. By half time he has managed **to brew** a strong wine, and the fans line up to taste what he **brewed**.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} lying on a *sleeping mat*. *Grass* grows up through the mat, thick and springy, until it puffs into the softest **mattress** in the world. Guests climb out of their beds and onto the roof. The Yogi floats gently on his grass **mattress** while forty tourists snore around him.

The {Ghost} rises silently from the {Trapdoor} of the {Hut}. Inside sits a *standing heart*, knitting. The Ghost shouts "BOO!" as a *jump scare*. The heart leaps three feet and flips upside down, **startled**. Then the heart shouts back "BOO!", and now the Ghost is so **startled** that he turns solid for a moment and drops his chains.

The {Chef} squats in the {Basement} of the {Boathouse}, where a single giant *eye* peers out of a pile of *autumn* leaves. The eye swivels to **look at** the Chef. The Chef **looks at** the eye. Each time a leaf falls, the eye blinks, and the Chef blinks too, until they're having a staring contest that lasts till winter.

The {Magician} pops out of the {Trapdoor} by the {Pool} just as the sun sinks into the tall *grass* around it. He waves his wand and the sky turns orange, then purple. "Behold, **evening**!" Swimmers yawn and put on pyjamas. He waves again, the evening deepens, and bats swoop over the water in the **evening** gloom.

The {Yogi} floats up the {Staircase} of the {Spa} into a *crossroads* where four corridors meet. In the middle stands a big *speaker* shouting new rules: "No splashing! Fill in form 27B!" This is the **government office**. Bathers queue in towels for permits. The Yogi needs a stamp from the **government office** just to breathe.

The {Juggler} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Yeti Cave}, and a *sentry* with a spear blocks his way. A *small speech bubble* pops out of the sentry's mouth: "Thou shalt not juggle!" It's a **commandment**. The bubble carves itself into the cave wall in stone letters. The Juggler secretly juggles snowballs behind the **commandment**.

The {Firefighter} kicks down the door of the {Basement} at the {Pool}. A *father* in a swimsuit stands there holding an enormous *axe*. "Too big for chopping kindling," he says, and shrinks it by blowing on it, into a neat little **hatchet**. The Firefighter borrows the **hatchet** and chops the pool's inflatable crocodile into kindling.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Beach} hut, between two velvet *curtains*. He opens his mouth and a *puff of breath* rolls out as a long poetic sigh: "**Ah**…". The waves stop to listen. He sighs again, "Oh sea, **ah**," and seagulls weep into their chips. It is the **poetic ah**.

The {Hunter} crawls out of the {Trapdoor} at the {Swan Pond}, all muddy. A *campfire* flares and a swan gives him a *makeover*: soap, comb, a silk jacket. He steps into the firelight **shining** like a new coin. The swans gasp. His boots, his teeth, his hat are all **shining**, and fish leap out to see their reflection in him.

The {Zookeeper} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Lagoon} boathouse where a *tree* grows out of an *ancestral hall*. Every leaf, branch and ancestor's portrait inside is **brown**. He touches the tree and his white uniform turns **brown**, then his parrot, then the lagoon itself, like a giant mug of tea.

The {Yogi} rises through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse}, where a *standing person* is about to sail into a storm. The Yogi stretches out a *feeding hand* full of rice and sprinkles it over them, humming, **to bless** the boat. Lightning bends politely around the mast. The sailor goes home safe, **blessed**, and her boat is blessed too.

The {Sailor} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} when a horse gallops past below. Its *mouth* opens in a wild **neigh** so loud there's a *tearing* sound, like ripping cloth. The beehive rips in half. Bees pour out. The horse **neighs** again, and the Sailor's trousers tear clean in two.

The {Juggler} pops out of a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} in front of a painted *woman* holding a cherry-blossom *branch*. She is a **prostitute** in an old story, a courtesan who sings at banquets. She tosses him the branch, he juggles it with three melons, and the **prostitute** in the story finally gets a better job, as his assistant.

The {Shepherd} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Mint} where coins are being stamped. Every coin is a little *mouth* shouting. He grabs a *megaphone* to shout "Quiet!" but the megaphone just amplifies the **clamor**: clanking, yelling, sheep bleating. The mint workers can't hear themselves think, and the **clamor** shakes coins off the roof.

The {Robot} clanks up the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} holding a *container* of lotus seeds and *grass*. It crushes them in its metal claws, squish, squish, into a sweet **paste**. The paste is so sticky that the Robot's feet glue to every step. It spends all night trapped on the stairs, coated in lotus **paste**.

The {Sheriff} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} with a *bamboo book* listing every outlaw. A *standing knife* slices along each line, scraping the names away one by one **to delete** them. "Now there's no crime!" declares the Sheriff. Then the knife **deletes** his own name, and he vanishes from the roof.

The {Yogi} meditates on the {Rooftop} of the {Boxing Ring} under a *tree* full of pink blossoms. A *baby* climbs up the branches and shakes them. Down tumble ripe **cherry** after **cherry**, bouncing off the Yogi's bald head, ping, ping, ping. He keeps meditating, now covered in red juice, while the baby eats the cherries.

The {Tsar} sits in the {Trapdoor} of the {Beehive} like a throne. A *standing person* runs back and forth to **wait on** him, bringing honey and slippers, fanning him with a leaf. The *boss* bee buzzes in and makes them **wait on** her too, so the poor servant juggles honey for the Tsar and the bee at once.

The {Wizard} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Jungle} canopy, where *grandpa* is fast asleep in a hammock. Grandpa's *mouth* opens and out comes not a snore but a **buzz**: bzzzzz. The jungle bees think he's their queen and swarm around him. The Wizard waves his wand to stop it, and his wand starts to **buzz** too.

The {Ghost} floats up the {Staircase} of the {Hut} and finds a *woman* so **beautiful** the stairs light up under her feet. A *spearman* guards her, pointing his spear at the Ghost. The Ghost bows and offers her a rose. She smiles, and even the Ghost turns **beautiful** for a moment, glowing pink.

The {Sheriff} climbs onto the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} and keeps climbing, up a *tree* that grows out of the chimney. At the very top, on the thinnest **branch tip**, hangs a *portrait* of the Sheriff himself, swaying. He reaches for it, the **branch tip** bends like a fishing rod, and he swings over the town.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Spa} carrying sacks of *soil* and a giant *shell*. A flood of bath water is gushing down the corridor. He piles the soil, wedges the shell in the middle and builds a **dam**. The water stops. Bathers float behind the **dam** like ducks in a pond, and the Baker sells them buns.

The {Tsar} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} and finds a fat white *bug* munching mulberry leaves under the open *sky*. It spins and spins until it wraps the Tsar in silk from his crown to his boots. "A **silkworm**!" he roars from his cocoon. The **silkworm** bows, and makes him a pair of silk pyjamas as an apology.

The {Firefighter} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} with a bucket of sticky *ointment* and a *cane*. Sunburned swimmers line up. She dips the cane in the ointment and starts **to spread** it on them, slap, slap, slap. Then she **spreads** it on the chimney, the gutter and a seagull, which slides off the roof.

The {Lifeguard} runs up the {Staircase} of the {Mansion} just as *water drops* splash over the *railing*. Then **big waves** crash through the windows, rolling up the stairs, one after another. The Lifeguard grabs the railing and surfs on a tea tray. The butler sails past in a bathtub, riding the **big waves** like a pro.

The {Shepherd} pops up through the {Trapdoor} into the {Boxing Ring}, where a *tree* is growing. A huge *mouth* has opened in its trunk and spits out round orange **apricots** like a pitching machine: pow, pow, pow. The boxers dodge and catch them. The Shepherd eats one, juice everywhere: the sweetest **apricot** he has ever tasted.

The {Sailor} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Waiting Room}, where an angry crowd is shouting about delays. A *soothing hand* ties each angry person with soft *silk thread* and pats them on the head **to pacify** them. They calm down one by one and fall asleep, snoring. The Sailor is **pacified** too, and drools on the doctor.

The {Yogi} climbs down into the {Basement} of the {Hut}, which is a furnace room. Sharp *icicles* hang from the ceiling, but he puts them on a *stage* in front of the furnace and they melt and glow. He pours in iron ore and begins **to smelt** it, red-hot metal dripping. The Yogi **smelts** a perfect copper teapot.

The {Baker} falls through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} as a storm hits. Two *twins* are being pelted by rain. He builds a little *shed* over them out of baguettes **to protect** them. Hail bounces off the bread roof. The twins nibble the walls. "I'll **protect** you," says the Baker, and adds a croissant chimney.

The {Ninja} sneaks up the {Staircase} of the {Tower} to the *emperor*'s chamber. A huge *helping hand* creeps out of his sleeve and starts **to scratch** the emperor's back. The emperor purrs. Then it **scratches** his nose, his chin, his crown, until the emperor giggles and makes the Ninja his royal back-scratcher.

The {Lifeguard} squeezes into the {Basement} of the {Boathouse}, where a woman with a *tall bun* is crying. A *helping hand* the size of a canoe reaches out and wraps around them both **to hug** them. The tall bun squashes flat. The hand **hugs** harder, and the Lifeguard's whistle squeaks.

The {Sheriff} is drinking tea on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool} when, **sudden**ly, without warning, a swimmer shoots up out of the water and lands in his cup. Then, equally **sudden**, the swimmer is gone, and so is the tea. The Sheriff blinks. The whole roof was a blur. Things around this pool happen fast.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yeti Cave} and finds an *eavesdropper* with three huge ears pressed to the wall. Each ear has a name tag reading **Nie**. "My name is **Nie**," says the eavesdropper, "and I hear everything." The Yeti whispers a secret. All three ears blush.

The {Wizard} hurries down to the {Basement} of the {Mansion}. A *woman* holds out a *rice bowl* of burnt porridge. Instead of saying "this is awful", the Wizard says, very **tactful**ly, "How brave and smoky!" The woman beams. He is **tactful** again with the burnt toast, then secretly feeds both to the cat.

The {Zookeeper} plummets through the {Trapdoor} of the {Tower} into a room where a thousand birds sit on wires. Their *birdsong* rolls into one giant *mouth* in the middle that blasts it out: shrieking, chirping, honking. The **noise** cracks the windows. The Zookeeper's earmuffs explode. Even the tower bell covers its ears from the **noise**.

The {Juggler} bursts out of a {Trapdoor} in the middle of the {Piazza} juggling a *grain stalk*. Each time he throws it, it lands and plants itself, until the piazza is a golden field of **crops** around a little farm *home*. The café tables vanish under wheat. The waiters, grumbling, become farmers and harvest the **crops** with butter knives.

The {Cheerleader} jogs up the {Staircase} at the {Beach} and meets a *fish* with a long white beard: *great-grandpa* fish, a hundred years old. He waves one **fin** at her. She cheers, he flaps the other **fin** in time, and soon the old fish is doing perfect pom-pom routines with his fins on the steps.

The {Lifeguard} jogs down the {Staircase} into the {Boxing Ring}, which has flooded into a pond full of floating *grass*. Each boxer must do a *hill climb* over a spiky black nut with two horns: a **water caltrop**. The Lifeguard steps on one. "OUCH!" He hops round the ring while the referee boils a **water caltrop** for lunch.

The {Jockey} rides down into the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, where two *twin blades* are slicing a big *dish* into smaller and smaller pieces. Finally it is shaved down into one dainty **small cup**, perfect for tea. The jockey sips from it, gasps, and the blades start making another **small cup** for his horse.

The {Ninja} slips through a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} and jumps into an *open crate* full of sand. A *lookalike*, another ninja exactly like him, jumps into the crate too. They both pull the lid closed **to hide**. The police open the crate and find only sand and two pairs of eyes. The ninjas are **hiding** perfectly, apart from the giggling.

The {Jockey} sits on the {Rooftop} of the {Beehive} on a thin *branch*. The branch opens a tiny *mouth* and lets out a long **creak**: "eeeeek." The bees freeze. He shifts his weight. **Creak**! The branch creaks louder and louder until it snaps, and the jockey lands in the honey.

The {Cheerleader} tiptoes down into the {Basement} of the {Inn} carrying a pillow. She crawls under a low *roof* propped over a mattress: a secret **bedroom**. She tries to sleep but keeps doing star jumps in her dreams, bumping the roof. Soon every guest in the inn sneaks down to her **bedroom** to join the sleepover.

The {Lifeguard} dives into the {Basement} of the {Mansion} where a *sightseer* is taking photos. A giant *helping hand* swoops out of a portrait **to seize** the camera, the hat, then the sightseer himself. It seizes the Lifeguard too and squeezes them together for a selfie. "Stop **seizing** things!" shouts the butler.

The {Sailor} sits in the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room}, gnawing on a huge *bone*. A little *tagalong* dog follows him everywhere, drooling. The Sailor cracks the bone open and slurps out the soft **marrow**. The tagalong begs. He shares, and the two of them sit slurping **marrow** while the nurse calls their names.

The {Baker} clambers down into the {Basement} of the {Boxing Ring} with a *grain stalk*. His hand closes round it and a *long comb* in his other hand teases it straight. He holds it up like a torch **to grasp** it firmly. No one can pull it away; the boxers try. He keeps it **grasped** through ten rounds, and bakes it into a loaf.

The {Baker} tumbles into the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a *seedbed* is full of baby birds, each with a wide open *mouth*. He breaks bread into crumbs and drops it in, beak by beak, **to feed** them. They chirp for more. He empties the bakery into the basement **feeding** them, and the chicks grow as big as swans.

The {Sheriff} lurks in the {Basement} of the {Beehive} with a bow and one long *arrow*. He fires it at a wasp. The **arrow** misses, ricochets off a honey jar, flies round the basement and comes back to pin his hat to the wall. He fires another **arrow** and this one comes back carrying a honey sandwich.

The {Pirate} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Spa} with a huge *mouth* painted on his belly. He gives one thunderous *clap*: **pop**! A bubble in the hot tub pops. Clap: **pop**! The bathers' shower caps pop off one by one. On the final clap, the pirate's belly button pops off too.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Beehive} and ties his sweaty *towel* to a stick. A *lone bird* lands on top and spreads its wings across it. Now it flaps like a proud **flag**. The bees all salute. The Jockey marches round the hive waving the towel **flag**, and the bird crows the national anthem.

The {Sheriff} opens a {Trapdoor} in the {Tower} and finds a *town crier* standing on a *hillside* that is somehow inside the tower. The crier rings his bell and bellows, "Oyez! Everyone here is now named **Shao**!" The Sheriff checks his badge: it says **surname Shao**. The tower's pigeons all get name tags too.

The {Sailor} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Boathouse} drinking lemonade through a *sipping straw*. It goes down the wrong way. His *mouth* opens: "HACK! HACK!" He starts **to cough** so hard the straw shoots out like a dart and pops a lifeboat. Every **cough** blows another boat across the harbour.

The {Shepherd} slips on the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} and a giant *helping hand* holding iron *tongs* grabs him by the belt. The tongs **clasp** him tight under the hand's arm like a parcel. The Yeti strolls past and gets **clasped** too. The hand carries both of them down the stairs.

The {Gardener} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Hangar} and finds a *clay jar* on a *workbench*. It keeps growing every time he pours water in, until it is a huge **vat** taller than a plane. He climbs in to clean it and his voice booms like a gong. Pilots come up to swim in the **vat**.

The {Robot} clanks up the {Staircase} of the {Boathouse} with a lump of dough. A *springy twig* boings out of its chest and a *helping hand* grabs the dough **to knead** it: push, fold, push, fold. The robot copies, **kneading** everything it touches, including the captain's hat, which rises into a loaf.

The {Ninja} drops through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} and finds the *moon* sunbathing, covered in suntan oil. It is so **greasy** that a *second coin* tossed onto it just slides off. The Ninja tries to climb on and slips. Even his sword gets **greasy**, and he spends the night skidding along the sand.

The {Shepherd} bursts through the {Trapdoor} into the {Dunes}, where a wild *horse* gallops across the sand. He tosses a rope and splashes it into a *river* to cool it. The horse calms down, drinks and lets him ride. He starts **to tame** it, and the horse is **tamed** so well it carries his sheep home one by one.

The {Lifeguard} slides into the {Basement} of the {Mansion}, where a *sightseer* is tied up in *silk thread*. He twists the thread round and round until it becomes a thick **cable**, and the sightseer is lifted up the stairs on a cable car. Other tourists cheer and book tickets for the **cable** ride.

The {Sheriff} crawls down into the {Basement} of the {Hangar} and finds the *sun* trapped there. A rusty *weathervane* spins and points straight up. "It's **midday**!" he cries, and the sun shoots out through the roof to the top of the sky. Exactly at **midday** every pilot stops for a sandwich.

The {Tailor} climbs to the {Rooftop} of the {Mansion} with a *sickbed*. He lies down on it and a *caught bird* in a net flutters onto his chest. He tries to get up but can't move a finger: he's **paralyzed** with laziness. The bird can't move either. The butler finds them both **paralyzed**, snoring in the sun.

The {Jockey} drops through the {Trapdoor} by the {Pool} into a *storeroom* stuffed with seashells. Each *shell* holds a coin. The jockey stacks them on shelves **to store** them, but they keep rolling out. He stuffs them in his boots, hat and pockets. Soon the pool has no room left **to store** anything, even the swimmers.

The {Magician} drops through the {Trapdoor} onto the {Beach} and a giant *claw* lifts him up. A *watcher* with binoculars sits on the claw scanning the sand. "We **seek** buried treasure," the watcher says. The claw digs everywhere, tossing up sandcastles. They **seek** all day and find only the Magician's lost rabbit.

The {Magician} creeps up the vine-covered {Staircase} in the {Jungle}. The *moon* is wearing a *blindfold*, so the night is **dim**, just a blur of grey shapes. He trips over a snoozing tiger. "Turn up the moon!" he shouts. The moon peeks out under its blindfold, but everything stays **dim**.

The {Pirate} drops through the {Trapdoor} onto a **remote** {Beach} at the end of the world. A *standing person* is there already, a *pioneer* in a fur hat with a flag. "Nobody comes here, it's too **remote**," says the pioneer. The pirate buries his treasure, and the pioneer charges him rent for the sand.

The {Sailor} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Waiting Room}, which leads to a grassy *hillside*. An emperor in yellow robes is digging a canal there with a tiny spoon. "I am from the **Sui dynasty**!" he declares. The patients help him dig, and the canal reaches the doctor's office: built by the **Sui dynasty** in one afternoon.

The {Magician} opens the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} and a *long veil* of *grass* creeps out, stretching tendrils across the floor. It's a **creeper**! It winds up the piano, the chandelier and the butler's legs. The Magician pulls a rabbit out of his hat, and the **creeper** grabs that too.

The {Zookeeper} stumbles into the {Basement} of the {Spa} and opens a box. A *jack-in-the-box* springs out with a wide *mouth* yelling "**How**? **How**?" How did it get here? How do you shut it? The Zookeeper pushes it down; it pops up again: "How?"

The {Cheerleader} falls through the {Trapdoor} of the {Yen Exchange} onto a *mountain* of coins. A kid with a *sweet tooth* presses gumdrops into the coins **to inlay** them like jewels. The Cheerleader starts **inlaying** too, sticking candy into her pom-poms. The bank manager weeps at the sticky treasure.

The {Cheerleader} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Yen Exchange} and meets a *tiger* with a *tattoo* of a temple on its back. It kneels at every step, very **reverent**, bowing to the cash machines. She stops cheering and bows too. Bankers, silent and **reverent**, light incense beside the tills.

The {Pirate} crashes through the {Trapdoor} of the {Mansion} into a muddy *rice field* in the cellar. He walks only along one **side** of it, exactly *half* the path. The butler, on the other **side**, shouts "This side is mine!" They argue across the field until the ducks take both sides.

The {Sailor} crawls into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse}, where a *king* sits on an upturned bucket worrying about **trifling** things: a bent paper clip, a sock with a hole, a crumb. He sends the Sailor to fetch each one. The king spends all day on **trifling** jobs while the warehouse burns down behind him.

The {Dentist} wobbles up the {Staircase} of the {Yeti Cave} carrying a flat *stone*. He sweeps the *leaves* off it, polishes it, and it becomes a perfect **plate**. The Yeti eats dinner from it, then smashes it like at a wedding. The Dentist carves another **plate** from the next stone.

The {Sailor} falls through the {Trapdoor} into the {Hut}, where *water drops* drip from a green persimmon on the ceiling. He licks one. His mouth puckers up so tight he can't speak. It is **astringent**, dry as sandpaper. The cat licks a drop too and its whiskers curl. Everything in the hut tastes **astringent**.

The {Lifeguard} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Lagoon} at night. A *dragon* swims across the *moon* puffing smoke, and everything turns **hazy**, blurred and soft. The lifeguard can't find the lagoon. He blows his whistle into the **hazy** fog, and the dragon sneezes the moon clean again.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Pool}, where a giant *mouth* blows a trumpet over the *capital city*. **Toot**! Every car in the city stops. **Toot** toot! All the buses honk back. The Dentist checks the mouth's teeth while it toots the national anthem.

The {Baker} drops through the {Trapdoor} into the {Jungle} just as an *avalanche* of coconuts rolls down a hill. His *kicking foot* starts **to hop**, boing, boing, over every coconut. Monkeys join in. The whole jungle **hops** like popcorn, and the Baker hops all the way home with a coconut stuck on his head.

The {Jockey} rides into the {Basement} of the {Lagoon} and sees a mound of earth under a *cloth cover*. A *shackled pig* pokes its head out of the soil. It is a **burial mound**, but the pig refuses to stay buried. It sings sea shanties from the **burial mound** until the jockey sets it free.

The {Lifeguard} sits on the {Staircase} of the {Youth Hostel} as *water drops* stream down a phone screen. A *tattooed blade* scrolls through it, flicking past pictures like flipping pages. "I'm only going to **browse**," he says. Six hours later the whole hostel is still **browsing** with him.

The {Yogi} pops out of a {Trapdoor} on the {Beach} wearing a long *robe*. A *skylight* opens in the sand, and up climb his **descendants**: children, grandchildren, great-grandchildren, all in tiny robes. More and more **descendants** keep coming until the beach is packed with Yogis meditating.

The {Juggler} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Inn} in a fancy *shirt*. On the **lapel** grows a little *forbidden grove* of tiny trees nobody may touch. A squirrel sneaks up his sleeve to steal an acorn. "Off my **lapel**!" he cries, and juggles the squirrel instead.

The {Dentist} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Tower} with a talking *mouth* that won't stop: "and another thing, and another thing…". It's so **garrulous** that he waves a *knife* to cut a word off. The mouth just talks faster. Birds fall asleep. Even the knife gets **garrulous** and starts chatting about cutlery.

The {Juggler} climbs the {Staircase} of the {Ice Rink} where a *small speech bubble* whispers a secret: wear the *archer's ring*. He slips it on and suddenly he has the **knack**: he juggles ten skates while spinning on one toe. Every skater wants the **knack**, and the bubble starts charging for lessons.

The {Shepherd} pops out of the {Trapdoor} of the {Museum} at dawn holding a *crowbar*. He wedges it under the *sun*, which is stuck behind a dinosaur skeleton, and levers it up. The **rising sun** glows over the exhibits. The dinosaurs yawn and stretch. Every morning he levers up the **rising sun** again.

The {Shepherd} stands on the {Rooftop} of the {Piazza} clock tower. A pink *bug* with a curled tail crawls *downstairs* towards the fountain, then another, then a thousand. **Shrimp**! They pile into the fountain, which boils, and the whole piazza smells of garlic and **shrimp**.

The {Baker} plunges through the {Trapdoor} by the {Pool} carrying *bamboo* slips. A *floodplain* of water pours in, and every slip floats into place, stitching itself into a soggy **register**. The Baker calls the roll of swimmers. Every name in the **register** splashes "Here!"

The {Pirate} sits on the {Staircase} at the {Beach} with a huge *mouth* gulping foaming **beer**. A palm-leaf *fan* waves the foam into the air in bubbles that drift off over the waves. Seagulls catch them and burp. The pirate orders another **beer** from a crab with a tray.

The {Cheerleader} cartwheels up the {Staircase} of the {Inn} after a runaway *fowl*. A giant *helping hand* swoops down **to capture** it. Feathers explode. The hand grabs the fowl, then the innkeeper, then the Cheerleader. "We are **captured**!" she cheers, waving her pom-poms from inside its fist.
